title: Cochrane systematic-review infrastructure: synthesis, updating, and plain-language evidence rail
summary: Promotes Cochrane systematic-review infrastructure: synthesis, updating, and plain-language evidence rail as a de-adoption/practice-lag infrastructure record. The record is not an incident or trial record; it describes a rail by which negative evidence can become reviewable, discussable, recommended against, or translated into practice constraints.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass source-backed extraction; child record and second-pass systematic-review extraction required for mature synthesis
limitations: Not medical advice and not a current clinical recommendation engine.
Uses exact indication/population/endpoints available in one-pass sources; child records needed for all subgroups and guideline dates.
Practice-lag claims require fuller utilization and reimbursement child records before maturity.
topic coverage and update lag vary
review conclusions still need guideline/practice translation
type_payload.query_value: A synthesis rail linking negative trials and medical reversals to aggregated evidence and public-facing summaries.

handling_notes: Clinical reversals can involve real patients who made choices under uncertainty; avoid hindsight contempt.
Do not treat procedure de-adoption as a patient-specific treatment recommendation.
Preserve the difference between “no benefit in studied population” and “never useful.”

revision_history.action: structural audit backfill: added unknowns/next_actions without changing factual claims or status

revision_history.change: Claim support migrated to typed evidence_refs; factual claim text and statuses unchanged.

unknowns: The update history, review-level certainty, and protocol-to-review lag for specific Cochrane reviews are not extracted.
The record does not yet distinguish review production, living-review maintenance, plain-language dissemination, and guideline uptake.
Coverage of fields outside medicine/public health is not assessed.
next_actions: Create child records for specific reviews only after protocol, review, update, and downstream guideline/practice links are located.
Map Cochrane review outputs into the factor axis correction_surface and review_depth.
Add cases where systematic reviews narrowed but did not remove a practice.
